data.description:
Discover a new world of music with HyperSpace Music, the ultimate VR app for Oculus headsets. HyperSpace Music revolutionizes your auditory experience by transforming your favorite MP3 tracks into breathtaking visual masterpieces.

Simply load your MP3 files into the default "music" folder on your headset, and let HyperSpace Music do the rest. Each song is brought to life through stunning, real-time visualizers that respond dynamically to the beats, rhythms, and melodies of your music. Whether you're grooving to pop, rocking out to metal, or relaxing with classical tunes, HyperSpace Music creates an immersive visual landscape that complements every genre.

Dive into a vibrant universe where sound and sight merge, offering an unparalleled sensory adventure. Customize your experience with various visual themes and effects, ensuring that no two journeys are ever the same. HyperSpace Music is perfect for music lovers, VR enthusiasts, and anyone looking to elevate their listening experience.

App Created by Krish T & Vicente M - Future Productions Films
Video Backgrounds - Björn Richter & TellSoto
Space Cover Art - Photo by Felix Mittermeier

Hyperspace Music v1.1.6 is Here! 

Just when you thought it couldn’t get any better... it did!

New Cinematic Film Effects:

We’ve added stunning cinematic effects to enhance your cosmic journey. These are just the beginning—more tweaks and improvements are coming in future updates!

(Previous Update v1.1.5 Recap)

Smoother Starfighter Animations:

Ships glide more fluidly than ever, with improved animations and even more enhancements on the way.

10 Visualizer Scenes:

Explore 10 mesmerizing scenes, perfectly synced to your music.

UI Upgrades:

Access the menu with both A and B buttons.
The menu now drifts smoothly as you look around.

DOWNLOAD NOW!

- Credit Update -

App Created by Krish T & Vicente M - Future Productions Films
UI & Additional Development by Hemal B 
Video Backgrounds - Björn R & TellSoto

Dear Hyperspace Travelers,

Your journey just got smoother and more spectacular! 

What’s New in v1.1.5?

Starfighter Enhancements: Fighter ships now feature smoother movements and upgraded animations, with even more improvements coming in the next update.

Scene Smoothness: We’ve added enhanced fluidity across all visual scenes, making your hyperspace experience more immersive than ever.

UI Upgrades:
The menu is now accessible with both the A and B buttons for easier navigation.

The UI menu drifts gracefully as you look around, blending seamlessly into the experience.

10 Visualizer Scenes: Explore 10 unique visualizer scenes, each offering a stunning journey synced to your music.

Thank you for flying with Hyperspace Music. Keep exploring, stay strong, and let the stars be your guide! 

- The Hyperspace Music Team

Dear Hyperspace Travelers,

We’ve made exciting upgrades to your journey through the cosmos! �

What’s New in v1.1.4

Two New Visualizers: Dive into stunning new visuals that elevate your music experience to galactic heights.

Starfighter Tweaks: Our starfighters have been fine-tuned for sharper details and a more immersive feel.

On the Horizon

Enhanced Ship Animations: Get ready for smoother, more dynamic starfighter animations in the next update—your flights are about to get even more thrilling!

Thank you for traveling with us. Keep exploring, keep grooving, and let the music guide your way through the stars!

The Hyperspace Music Team

Dear Hyperspace passengers, we have an exciting new update. All the scenes and music flow constantly. Your music is no longer interrupted by switching scenes.

The fighter movement will change in scene two from month to month to keep things unique.


Please enjoy this update we are busy making more great visuals in the next few weeks.

Many Thanks
Hyperspace Music Team

URGENT CRITICAL UPDATE:

Dear Hyperspace Travellers,

Welcome back to the journey through the stars! We’ve made three updates today to bring you even more exciting improvements and serious progress in Hyperspace Music.

Please install this latest update for the best experience.

Update Log:

Thrusters Upgraded: We've added more intricate details and flames to the starfighter thrusters, bringing more dynamic energy to your hyperspace journey.

Starfighter Formations: Starfighters now fly in tight formation with smoother, more detailed animations, offering a sense of precision and intensity during your missions.

Hyperspace Window: The hyperspace window layer has been opened and added, giving you a breathtaking visual experience as you blast through the cosmos.

Cinematic Color Correction: We’ve added cinematic color correction to some of the scenes, enhancing the overall visual tone and atmosphere.

Please note that these changes are temporary. Our team will be pushing the playlist feature in the next update after the 15th, and as a result, this visual work will need to be redone. It may not look quite the same afterward, so enjoy the current enhancements while they last!

We’re thrilled about the serious progress we've made and what it means for the future of your journey. Stay tuned for more exciting updates!

- The Hyperspace Music Team

Dear Hyperspace Travelers,

Buckle up, as we're taking another leap into the cosmos!

We're excited to announce that the visual experience in Hyperspace Music has improved and will improve further in the next update. 

Here's what's new:

Resolution Boost: We've started enhancing the overall visual quality! The cockpit resolution has received a notable upgrade, bringing sharper details to your journey through space.

See you among the stars!

Hyperspace Music VR - Update Changelog

Hey Hyperspace Pilots,

We’re excited to share the latest update for Hyperspace Music VR! � 

While we’re still fine-tuning the ships and working hard on a much-anticipated playlist feature for the next release, here’s what’s new in this version:

Adjusted Lighting: We’ve enhanced the in-game lighting for a more immersive experience.

Exterior Ship Details: New visual details have been added to the ships' exteriors to bring more depth and realism to your journey.
Basic Heads-Up Display (HUD): We’ve introduced a simple HUD behind the menu in the cockpit. It’s a work in progress, and we’ll be improving it over time!

Thank you for being a part of this journey. More exciting updates are on the horizon!

Happy flying, The Hyperspace Music Team

Dear Hyperspace Travelers, 

Visualizer 2 and 9 now have a SR8 Fighter cockpit for you to ride in. This will get more detailed in time.

We are also currently working on playlist functionality, please expect that in the updates to come!

Stay Tuned!

Krish - Hyperpace Music

Dear Hyperspace Travelers,

We've just made your journey through the music cosmos even more mesmerizing!

We've also made some under-the-hood tweaks to boost performance and ensure a smoother, more immersive experience. Keep exploring and enjoy the enhanced vibes!

In the next few weeks we have some really cool updates coming, so please stay tuned!

Safe travels,
K -The Hyperspace Music VR Team

stay tuned for some really cool stuff coming soon!

Dear Friends,

2) An SR8 Spacefighter ship has been added to one of the scenes. (We will add in more ships and interior details in the next update)

Stay Tuned for a lot more exciting updates!

Dear All,

Thanks for joining us on the launch to Hyperspace!

We have a few exciting updates planned over the next few days, so please stay tuned.

We listened to some of your feedback and are currently relentlessly working on the rest of the changes.

For now this update brings:

1) A brand new visualizer inspired by the popular "Milkdrop" visualizer. This visualizer is called "Stardust" and features some cool abstract effects. This will only get better with time!

2) Web browsing and some Android 2D apps may work within app for Quest 2 and up.

Stay tuned, we will rollout more updates in a matter of days!

K
